mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.50%, it signals active monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.50%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS grow, or the interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO > 105), manufacturing output expansion signals robust economic activity that supports corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL growth > 0.2% monthly) erodes real corporate profits and prompts central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 0.2%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 850,000 units (HOUST < 850) signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 850, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline indicate labor market tightness that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.50% for 3 consecutive months), rising policy rates increase borrowing costs and dampen economic growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.50% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.
